fields.name: state_and_flags
fields.description: Lifecycle state and protocol flags. Encodes TB_MESSAGE_STATE_* and transport flags.

fields.name: disposition
fields.description: Message category: Query (1), Reply (2), Error (3), InitArgs (4).

fields.name: reserved_padding
fields.description: Alignment padding to 8-byte boundary.

fields.name: invocation_id
fields.description: Monotonically increasing 64-bit transaction nonce used to correlate replies to queries.

fields.name: endpoint_token
fields.description: Component / interface selector token targeting specific service method.

fields.name: payload_length
fields.description: Total length of serialized argument payload in bytes.

fields.name: capabilities_count
fields.description: Number of capabilities delegated in message (0 <= count <= TB_MAX_CAPS = 8).

fields.name: inline_payload
fields.description: Inline fast-path payload words transferred directly without buffer indirection.

fields.name: cursor_position
fields.description: Current read/write position of serialization cursor within buffer.

fields.name: transport_buffer
fields.description: Pointer to underlying transport buffer holding extended payload.

2.description: Payload sealed, ready for transport dispatch

4.description: Delivered to receiver, ready for decoder

1.description: RPC client request invoking remote method

2.description: RPC server response delivering return value

3.description: RPC failure notification with error code

floating_point_encoding.f32: IEEE 754 Single Precision (32 bits, Little Endian, encoded via tb_message_encode_f32_v2)
floating_point_encoding.f64: IEEE 754 Double Precision (64 bits, Little Endian, encoded via tb_message_encode_f64_v2)

dynamic_collection_framing.length_prefix: uint32_t or uint64_t count preceding packed elements

capability_delegation.encoding: Stored as 8-byte CNode slot indices in capability registers CR0..CR7

fields.name: total_size
fields.description: Total accumulated message payload size

fields.name: current_offset
fields.description: Current chunk insertion offset

fields.name: frame_count
fields.description: Number of mapped memory frames

fields.name: buffer_base
fields.description: Virtual memory pointer to mapped accumulation buffer

fields.name: part_index
fields.description: Sequential chunk index (0-based)

fields.name: part_count
fields.description: Total chunks comprising complete message

fields.name: part_offset
fields.description: Byte offset of current chunk in message

fields.name: part_size
fields.description: Byte count of current chunk

fields.name: total_message_size
fields.description: Total size across all chunks

fields.name: frame_cap
fields.description: L4 capability of memory frame backing this chunk

cL4.name: cL4 Inline Register IPC Transport
cL4.transfer_mechanism: Inline ARM64 registers (x0-x7) and Thread IPC Buffer (tpidrro_el0)
cL4.memory_allocation: Zero-allocation; operates strictly within static IPC buffer
cL4.target_traffic: RPC method queries, acknowledgments, token arbitration, short telemetry

cL4_large.name: cL4 Large Shared-Memory Transport
cL4_large.transfer_mechanism: Shared memory frame capability delegation with tb_message_accumulator_s
cL4_large.trap_vector: svc #0 signaling with L4_Cap_Mint_Arm64_Frame delegated in CR0
cL4_large.max_inline_bytes: Multi-megabyte payloads (up to maximum Conclave address space quota)
cL4_large.memory_allocation: Dynamic frame mapping via _map_this_frame in vascore
cL4_large.target_traffic: Sensor video frames, biometric facial vectors, crash stackshots, neural tensors
